title: Evaluation of an extended sign restriction
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $J$ be a set of coordinates among the $n$ coordinates, and let $z$ assign signs to the coordinates outside $J$. For any function $f$ on the sign cube and any sign vector $x$, the extended restriction evaluated at $x$ equals $f$ evaluated at the sign vector formed using $x$ on $J$ and $z$ outside $J$.
hypotheses_covered: $J$ is a finite set of coordinates among the n coordinates
$z$ assigns signs to the coordinates outside $J$
$f$ is a function on the sign cube
